local_inventory.source: 1999 Mw 6.6 Chamoli earthquake polygon inventory (Landsat 5 / IRS-1C); authors: Shivani Joshi, Akshat Vashistha, Srikrishnan Siva Subramanian, IIT Roorkee
local_inventory.note_outside: The 24 excluded polygons lie inside the DEM mosaic coverage (DEM x-range 210,577-405,542 UTM 44N; excluded polygons x 318,016-361,103). They were excluded solely by the Chamoli district AOI clip, not by data quality. Re-including them would redefine the study AOI; it requires a new dataset build, new split, and user approval - it is NOT done here.

nrsc_atlas_pdf.contents: NRSC/ISRO Landslide Atlas of India (Feb 2023): ~80,000 mapped landslides 1998-2022 across 17 states + 2 UTs; district exposure ranking; 1:25,000 LSZ (Landslide Susceptibility Zonation) maps for corridors incl. Rishikesh-Rudraprayag-Chamoli-Badrinath and Chamoli-Okhimath
reasons: PDF scans of maps; no coordinate-level labels without digitization
not validated for ML use (extraction pending per data/metadata/landslide_inventory_nrsc_status.json)
LSZ maps are model-derived susceptibility, not observed inventories
nrsc_atlas_pdf.atlas_text_contains: Chamoli (exposure rank 19; LSZ corridors through Chamoli)

locally_available_predictors.aspect_sin / aspect_cos: used in v2/v3 (recomputed from corrected aspect)
locally_available_predictors.plan/profile/mean curvature: derivable locally from DEM (v3 experimental feature); computed in this phase
locally_available_predictors.TWI: derivable but requires hydrological conditioning (pit filling, flow direction, accumulation); NOT computed; unreliable without conditioning
locally_available_predictors.continuous lithology/geology raster: NOT available locally (only per-polygon categorical attributes for the 73 inventory polygons)
locally_available_predictors.distance-to-fault / distance-to-road / d: NOT available locally (no fault/road/stream vector layers)
locally_available_predictors.rainfall: IMERG monthly zips 2000-2020 in data/raw/rainfall and data/raw/precipitation; 0.1deg (~10km) monthly grids; suitable for coarse event/seasonal context, NOT pixel-level predictors without major aggregation and new engineering; not used

external_verification_status: Web search was unavailable in this session (queries cancelled). All external candidates above are documented from general literature knowledge and MUST be independently verified (source, license, spatial/temporal coverage, and coordinate accuracy) before any acquisition or use.
geological_predictors_recommendation: The raw inventory attributes show strong lithologic and structural control: 62/73 polygons on Quartzite-phyllite-slate-limestone; 8 associated with Main Central thrust, 4 Vaikrita thrust, 1 Baijnath thrust; 6 near Birahi Ganga.
Priority new predictor: continuous lithology/geology raster (GSI 1:50,000 / 1:2,50,000) and distance-to-fault - both currently missing.
Secondary: distance-to-stream / drainage density, TWI (after DEM conditioning), LULC, and slope-curvature; curvature is derivable now.
feasibility_statement: Even with all locally derivable predictors, the positive class is 49 events (earthquake-triggered, one district). RF v3 can test better-regularized configurations, not reach operational accuracy. Any external inventory would need CRS/coordinate validation, trigger-type harmonization (co-seismic vs rainfall), and temporal alignment before use.
actions_not_taken: No new external data downloaded or fabricated.
The 24 out-of-district polygons were NOT re-included; doing so redefines the AOI and requires user confirmation.
NRSC Atlas pages were not digitized into inventories; LSZ maps are model outputs, not observed labels.
Web search for external inventories could not be performed (queries cancelled in this session).
